title: What’s the easiest way to get a playable version of a game idea?
author: No-Promotion8822
selftext: For indie creators, the technical barrier is often the hardest part. Even a simple co-op or adventure game can require days of setup and coding. I came across Onetap build where you describe your idea like explore a mysterious city or  survive on an island and it generates a playable version instantly. It doesn’t replace detailed development, but it’s great for testing ideas fast. Do you usually start with paper prototypes, small playable mechanics, or jump straight into building in an engine? How do you iterate quickly without losing the core idea?
